script.text: Okay... so I have a slightly awkward confession to make. And no, I promise this isn't me dramatically quitting the internet or staring out a rainy window with sad piano music.
Storytime animations are genuinely my favorite thing in the world to make, but drawing eighty frames of myself having an existential crisis takes... an embarrassing amount of time.
Between editing timelines, fixing weird hand drawings, and surviving on questionable amounts of iced coffee, it can get a little lonely sitting at this desk all night.
Which is why I finally made our own Discord server! It's called Nemi's Little Corner. Think of it as a cozy, slightly chaotic blanket fort where we can all actually hang out.
You can share your own art, vent about awkward life moments, give me ideas for upcoming stories, or just lurk quietly in the shadows. Fellow introverts are very welcome.
And for anyone who's ever asked how to directly help keep these animations going, I also set up a Ko-fi page.
Please don't feel pressured at all—seriously. Just watching these videos and leaving sweet comments already keeps my introverted soul alive.
But if you do want to toss a digital coffee my way, it directly helps cover drawing software, replacement tablet nibs, and emergency midnight snack runs so my hands don't stop sketching.
Both links are right down in the description. Thank you so much for being here with me. Come say hi in our little corner, and let's keep making weird stories together.
